description: Students with confirmed silent audio across all formats (WAV, m4a, webm). RMS=0 at all sampled positions for all available audio files. Audio was not captured during Zoom recording — microphone was inactive or not configured at the OS/browser level. These students have no recoverable speech data.
verification_method: ffprobe + ffmpeg raw PCM extraction (s16le 16kHz) at 30s offset, 60s window. All samples = 0 for all formats.
pipeline_instruction: For sessions listed here: set transcript_context to null, set diarization_status to 'no_audio_captured', skip speech-anchor frame extraction, use motion_threshold + codap_log triggers only.

affected_sessions.note: 8/13 students silent. Diarization files for silent students show status=no_speech, segments=[]. Frame extraction ran in motion_only_fallback mode for these students.

6/9 students with recordings are silent. 4 students (Iris, Marcus, Shana, Sheila) have no audio directory at all — absent from session. Ulysses has diarization file but 0 segments. Irma and Melinda confirmed with audio.

methodology_note: For affected students, MMLA v2 event JSON will carry transcript_context: null and behavioral_classification will rely solely on screen_ocr + log_context evidence. Confidence ratings will be downgraded from 'high' to 'medium' where speech would normally triangulate behavioral inferences. This limitation must be disclosed in the methodology section of any publication.
recovery_attempts: m4a RMS check (via ffmpeg): all zeros
webm opus stream RMS check (map 0:a:0 and map 0:1): all zeros
Checked 30s window at 60s offset to avoid silence at recording start/end
